**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeChangeEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeChangeEvent.java)

The change of a value of a node, with the value before and the value after, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`.

## Description

A `beforeX` listener receives a [`NodeChangeEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent-pre/) before the change and can refuse it; an `onX` listener receives a [`NodeChangeEvent.Post`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent-post/) once the value changed.
The moves of a node ([`Node.beforeMove`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-beforeMove), [`Node.onMove`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onMove)), the value of a checkbox, a toggle or a choice (`beforeChange`, `onChange`), the focus, the cursor and the selection of a field, the opening of a selector, and the zoom and the rotation of a [`ModelViewerNode`](/reference/nodes/modelviewernode/) use it.
